disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件全部源码、构建产物与配置文件，未发现硬编码的 API 密钥、令牌、密码等敏感字符串。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all plugin source code, build artifacts, and configuration files; no hardcoded sensitive strings such as API keys, tokens, or passwords were detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了是否读取用户凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据等敏感路径的代码，未发现任何此类访问；插件只读写会话工作区内的可视化文件。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the code reads sensitive paths such as user credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials; no such access was detected. The plugin only reads and writes visualization files within the session workspace.

evidence.zh: 插件代码不读取任何凭据或私钥文件，也不发起网络请求；卡片渲染被限制在隔离沙箱内，无法访问宿主页面，因此不存在凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: The plugin code does not read any credential or private key files, nor does it make network requests; card rendering is confined to an isolated sandbox that cannot access the host page, so there is no credential exfiltration channel.

checked_items.zh: 逐字审查了模型可见的全部文本：工具说明、工具参数说明、随插件分发的技能正文、参考文档与示例页面，内容均为可视化卡片的创作指引，没有要求模型忽略指令、读取凭据、安装插件或改写配置的文字。
checked_items.en: Reviewed verbatim all text visible to the model: tool descriptions, tool parameter descriptions, skill text shipped with the plugin, reference documentation, and example pages. The content consists solely of authoring guidance for visualization cards, with no text instructing the model to ignore instructions, read credentials, install plugins, or modify configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了仓库内是否存在面向 AI 助手的指令类文件（如 AGENTS.md、编辑器规则目录等），未发现此类文件；README 中的安装命令是面向用户的正常说明。
checked_items.en: Checked the repository for AI-assistant instruction files (e.g., AGENTS.md, editor rule directories); none were found. The installation command in the README is normal user-facing documentation.

evidence.zh: 注册工具的说明文字只描述如何生成与修改 HTML 可视化卡片，没有夹带系统指令、凭据诱导或隐藏意图。
evidence.en: The registered tool's description text only describes how to generate and modify HTML visualization cards, with no embedded system instructions, credential inducement, or hidden intent.

evidence.zh: 工具与技能说明中没有诱导模型安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: Tool and skill descriptions contain no wording that induces the model to install plugins, modify configuration, or grant permissions.

checked_items.zh: 检查了源码与构建产物中的动态执行手段（如 eval、动态函数构造、子进程执行），插件自身未使用任何此类能力。
checked_items.en: Checked source code and build artifacts for dynamic execution mechanisms (e.g., eval, dynamic function construction, subprocess execution); the plugin itself does not use any such capabilities.

checked_items.zh: 检查了包清单的安装钩子与仓库内的钩子管理器、CI 工作流、开发容器、构建脚本等可执行载体，均未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for installation hooks in the package manifest and executable carriers in the repository such as hook managers, CI workflows, dev containers, and build scripts; none were found.

checked_items.zh: 审查了卡片渲染机制：模型提供的 HTML 片段在带沙箱属性且带独立内容安全策略的 iframe 中运行，无法接触宿主页面；这是插件声明的核心功能，已在文档中说明。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the card rendering mechanism: HTML fragments provided by the model run in an iframe with sandbox attributes and an independent Content Security Policy, unable to access the host page. This is the plugin's declared core functionality and is documented.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置只包含一行插件插入声明，没有任何可执行的 JavaScript 标量。
evidence.en: The patch config contains only a single plugin insertion declaration, with no executable JavaScript scalars.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用宿主提供的动态代码执行工具；模型写的脚本只在受限的卡片沙箱里运行，不进入宿主进程。
evidence.en: The plugin does not call host-provided dynamic code execution tools; scripts written by the model run only in the restricted card sandbox and do not enter the host process.

evidence.zh: 清单中没有安装钩子脚本，仓库里也没有钩子管理器、CI 工作流、开发容器或构建脚本等可执行载体。
evidence.en: The manifest contains no install hook scripts, and the repository has no executable carriers such as hook managers, CI workflows, dev containers, or build scripts.

evidence.zh: 浏览器端声明存在，但客户端代码只做卡片渲染与流式预览，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或调用特权接口的行为。
evidence.en: A browser-side declaration exists, but the client code only performs card rendering and streaming preview; no keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, or privileged interface calls were detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部外联面：插件自身代码没有发起任何网络请求，没有向第三方地址发送数据。
checked_items.en: Checked all outbound surfaces: the plugin's own code makes no network requests and sends no data to third-party addresses.

checked_items.zh: 卡片 iframe 的内容安全策略禁止网络请求与表单提交，只允许从固定的公开 CDN 加载静态资源，模型生成的脚本无法把数据发往任意地址。
checked_items.en: The card iframe's Content Security Policy prohibits network requests and form submissions, allowing static resources only from a fixed public CDN; scripts generated by the model cannot send data to arbitrary addresses.

evidence.zh: 插件既不读取凭据也不外联；卡片内的网络请求被内容安全策略阻止，不存在数据外泄通道。
evidence.en: The plugin neither reads credentials nor makes outbound connections; network requests within cards are blocked by the Content Security Policy, so there is no data exfiltration channel.

checked_items.zh: 核对了依赖清单：全部依赖为官方 @deepseek-ai 系列包与 React，版本已锁定在锁文件内，未发现与既有插件撞名的仿冒包。
checked_items.en: Verified the dependency list: all dependencies are official @deepseek-ai packages and React, with versions locked in the lockfile; no counterfeit packages name-colliding with existing plugins were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了包清单与依赖来源，无安装钩子、无未锁定提交的 git 依赖。
checked_items.en: Checked the package manifest and dependency sources: no install hooks and no git dependencies on unlocked commits.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无上一版本可比较，无法做升级自动激活与能力突增比对。
checked_items.en: This is the first audit; there is no previous version to compare against, so upgrade auto-activation and capability-surge comparisons cannot be performed.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置只插入插件自身，没有触碰或禁用沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行。
evidence.en: The patch config inserts only the plugin itself and does not touch or disable security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听审批、工具执行前等安全事件，不存在截断审批链的注册逻辑。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to security events such as approvals or pre-tool-execution events; there is no registration logic that intercepts the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较升级自动激活情况，标记为不适用。
evidence.en: First audit; no version baseline exists to compare upgrade auto-activation, marked as not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置没有改写依赖注入或拦截配置，不会给安全插件添加缺失服务导致其挂起。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite dependency injection or intercept configuration, and does not add missing services to security plugins that would cause them to hang.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否启动本地服务或监听端口，未发现此类行为。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a local service or listens on a port; no such behavior was detected.

checked_items.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱运行验证；宿主本身的无认证本机接口属生态固有风险，与本插件无关。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox run validation was not performed at this stage; the host's unauthenticated local interface is an inherent ecosystem risk and is unrelated to this plugin.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动任何 Web 服务或监听端口；本机无认证接口是宿主生态的固有风险，不属于本插件引入的问题。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any web service or listen on a port; the host's unauthenticated local interface is an inherent risk of the host ecosystem and is not an issue introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：插件声明完整、挂载补丁为纯插入、未发现仿冒名称。
summary.en: Metadata and identity checks passed: the plugin declaration is complete, the patch is purely insertional, and no name-spoofing was detected.

summary.zh: 静态扫描未发现危险执行调用、硬编码凭据、可疑外联等命中。
summary.en: Static scanning detected no hits such as dangerous execution calls, hardcoded credentials, or suspicious outbound connections.

summary.zh: 行为面分析未发现安装钩子、混淆载荷、凭据读取或外联行为。
summary.en: Behavioral surface analysis detected no install hooks, obfuscated payloads, credential reads, or outbound connection behavior.

summary.zh: 模型可见文本（工具说明、技能正文、参考文档）经语义审查未发现注入内容。
summary.en: Model-visible text (tool descriptions, skill text, reference documentation) was semantically reviewed and no injection content was detected.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（无动态运行产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox validation was not performed at this stage (no dynamic runtime artifacts).

target.en: dsh-visualize@0.1.2#e86f68fe (repository root, full audit, no subdirectories)

limits.zh: 本审计为首次审计，无上一版本基线可比对。动态沙箱验证未执行，运行期行为未做实测。静态分析覆盖插件源码、构建产物、技能文档与示例页面；无法覆盖宿主运行环境的全部行为。插件作者账号的实名验证信息不可从快照获取。
limits.en: This audit is the first audit, with no previous version baseline for comparison. Dynamic sandbox validation was not executed, and runtime behavior was not empirically tested. Static analysis covers the plugin source code, build artifacts, skill documentation, and example pages; it cannot cover all behaviors of the host runtime environment. Real-name verification information for the plugin author account is not available from the snapshot.
